name: Fort Bend County, TX
findings: Fort Bend County has 2,432 nonprofit organizations. 860 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 657 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fort Bend County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list public events
observations.text: 16 arts and cultural organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 36 would.

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 264 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
